notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.3.0 — Team-safe Git

• Always up to date with your team: Vekrun checks GitHub before it integrates or syncs, and won't build on a branch that's behind ("develop is 2 commits behind origin/develop: update it first"). The branch list shows how current it is.
• Releases your way: a Release card on Project Delivery shows what develop has that master doesn't and opens one release pull request for exactly the commit you reviewed. Name release branches and titles with your own templates (release_{date}, release/{version} …) in the Git workflow settings.
• One pull request per project: when you plan a project, choose to deliver it as a single pull request (the default when your branch is protected), on a project branch named by your branch rules.
• Your Git workflow, confirmed: planning a project shows the workflow Vekrun inferred and asks you to confirm it; nothing is applied silently, and an unclear production branch is asked, not guessed.
• Crash-safe publishing: publishing again after an interruption finds the existing pull request instead of opening a second, and interrupted publishes are settled from GitHub at startup.
• When your branch moved on while the Factory worked: bring both together (proved first), keep the work on its own branch, or leave it.
• Project Delivery says who each Work Item waits on, and its history shows the branches and commits involved.

Certified live against a real GitHub repository with a protected master.
